findings.summary: Returning to preparation changes a link-plus-materials draft to file mode while retaining and submitting the now-hidden video link.
findings.fix: Restore the explicitly selected source on wizard-reset; when inferring, check video files, then video_url, then materials. Exclude inactive source values from submission and add a regression test that review, consent visibility, and submitted source agree after home/reopen.
findings.evidence: Repro: choose link, enter URL, attach TXT, check consent, enter code; breadcrumb home, reopen preparation, Next twice. Source becomes file; URL/consent/code hide; review says 학습자료만 준비. With browser-only mocked configured health, intercepted /video-link body still had the original URL, request_analysis:true and analysis_consent:true. No provider call occurred.

findings.summary: The roles browser check still submits the former one-page form without traversing the new three-step wizard.
findings.fix: Advance from step 1, explicitly select the file/material source in step 2, attach materials, advance to step 3, confirm rights, then submit. Assert the current step heading and retain overlay cancellation/focus coverage.
findings.evidence: Lines 100–110 fill title/materials and press rights/submit directly, then wait for the analysis overlay. They never operate #wizard-next or [data-wizard-source=file]. The parent audit reproduced the original script timing out at the overlay wait; source inspection confirms the stale sequence.

passed: Isolated keyboard-only flow completed guardian setup → student creation → sample preview → student selection → publish; feedback and focus were checked after each transition.
Wizard invalid URL and missing consent return to step 2, focus the offending input, set aria-invalid and associate the visible step error with aria-describedby.
Wizard previous/next preserves entered values; each normal transition focuses its step heading and updates aria-current=step.
Explicit switch to sample clears selected video, link, supplemental materials and consent before opening the visibly labeled deterministic sample.
Guide deep links open the corresponding disclosure; same-hash navigation reopens a collapsed disclosure; individual and expand-all/collapse-all buttons expose correct expanded states.
